about: Hook mechanisms for on-screen reaction-video text. Taxonomy after Zuhair Lakhani's public hook-writing guide (X, 2026-09-15); definitions paraphrased, no example lines copied. The text is the setup, the face is the answer.

drama.runs_on: a personal story already in motion, payoff withheld; trailing '..' instead of a full stop

story.runs_on: a specific person walking through something they did, with odd checkable numbers

credential.runs_on: an ordinary narrator borrowing a named role's authority

insider.runs_on: a closed or far-away world the viewer cannot see into, one word in caps

numbered.runs_on: a numbered contract made alive by one modifier; a bare 'N tips' is dead

diagnostic.runs_on: a self-check the viewer must run against a list

inversion.runs_on: naming the consensus and promising to break it

overheard.runs_on: someone else's words in quotes, slightly rude, doubles as comment bait

pov.runs_on: placing the viewer inside a frame

value.runs_on: no gap, just a thing almost everyone wants; only works if what follows is useful

fourthwall.runs_on: naming what the viewer is doing right now, then rewarding it

transformation.runs_on: before and after with a specific number, the how withheld; carries a product most naturally

wall.runs_on: one phone-typed lowercase thought of 30 to 50 words naming an irritation and a realization
